assetRequirement.source: Attach the provided hubside-cover.avif file to the Aippy prompt
assetRequirement.note: Use the Aippy HOST public folder (not imported upstream) so full-tree GitHub imports cannot delete this artwork. Install before the normal Vite build.

notes: GitHub source and standalone index.html use HubSide branding.
Image URL loads from the Aippy host public folder and falls back to the previous cover if absent.
Do not overwrite host root App.tsx, package.json, index.html, vite.config.ts, or importer.
Node 22 is only available during normal Vite build, not from Aippy chat.
